scope: Only five native creation tables' RLS flags, selected policies/trigger attachments and selected helper definition fingerprints; no business/Auth rows, function bodies, ACL-wide dump, private objects or server files; no writes.
query: SELECT jsonb_build_object('policies',(SELECT jsonb_agg(x) FROM (SELECT c.relname AS table_name,p.polname AS policy_name,p.polcmd AS command,p.polpermissive AS permissive,pg_catalog.pg_get_expr(p.polqual,p.polrelid) AS using_expression,pg_catalog.pg_get_expr(p.polwithcheck,p.polrelid) AS check_expression FROM pg_catalog.pg_policy p JOIN pg_catalog.pg_class c ON c.oid=p.polrelid JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname='shop_manager' AND c.relname IN ('quotes','quote_items','customers','vehicles','work_orders') ORDER BY c.relname,p.polname LIMIT 60) x),'triggers',(SELECT jsonb_agg(x) FROM (SELECT c.relname AS table_name,t.tgname AS trigger_name,t.tgenabled AS enabled,pg_catalog.pg_get_triggerdef(t.oid) AS definition,t.tgfoid::regprocedure::text AS function_signature,md5(pg_catalog.pg_get_functiondef(t.tgfoid)) AS function_definition_md5 FROM pg_catalog.pg_trigger t JOIN pg_catalog.pg_class c ON c.oid=t.tgrelid JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname='shop_manager' AND c.relname IN ('quotes','quote_items','customers','vehicles','work_orders') AND NOT t.tgisinternal ORDER BY c.relname,t.tgname LIMIT 60) x),'helpers',(SELECT jsonb_agg(x) FROM (SELECT p.oid::regprocedure::text AS function_signature,p.prosecdef AS security_definer,pg_catalog.pg_get_userbyid(p.proowner) AS owner,md5(pg_catalog.pg_get_functiondef(p.oid)) AS function_definition_md5 FROM pg_catalog.pg_proc p JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace n ON n.oid=p.pronamespace WHERE n.nspname='shop_manager' AND p.proname IN ('get_current_user_shop_id','user_belongs_to_shop','is_owner_or_admin','get_current_user_roles','generate_work_order_number') ORDER BY p.oid::regprocedure::text LIMIT 20) x),'rls',(SELECT jsonb_agg(x) FROM (SELECT c.relname AS table_name,c.relrowsecurity AS enabled,c.relforcerowsecurity AS forced FROM pg_catalog.pg_class c JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname='shop_manager' AND c.relname IN ('quotes','quote_items','customers','vehicles','work_orders') ORDER BY c.relname LIMIT 5) x)) AS selected_metadata;

triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER employee_operation_audit AFTER INSERT OR DELETE OR UPDATE ON shop_manager.customers FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION shop_manager.capture_employee_operation()
CREATE TRIGGER trg_generate_quote_number BEFORE INSERT ON shop_manager.quotes FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION shop_manager.generate_quote_number()
CREATE TRIGGER employee_operation_audit AFTER INSERT OR DELETE OR UPDATE ON shop_manager.work_orders FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION shop_manager.capture_employee_operation()
CREATE TRIGGER trg_generate_work_order_number BEFORE INSERT ON shop_manager.work_orders FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION shop_manager.generate_work_order_number()
